claims.claim: The paper platform is declared in config as solana, pumpfun-bonding-curve, paper, quote-only Jupiter Swap V2. It selects no endpoint.
The wallet allowlist holds public keys only and ships empty. Secret-key-length values are refused and not echoed.
Live gate row 5 stays unmet while the allowlist is empty, and row 6 is met at the 1 SOL ceiling. Live still exits 3.
The scheduled promotion check searches only an owner-declared space, reads autonomy from the operator ledger, and promotes only at autonomous-paper. The shipped space is empty, so it is skipped.
Replay output is unchanged: smoke-10m events.hash b69c2959...b32d before and after.

Greptile threads on PR 22 are addressed in code: autonomy source, uncaught declaration errors, incomplete paper window, risk settings, manifest save, settlement-internal equity, genesis refusal, probe path credentials, runbook key names, serve resume, and exit reload. CORRECTION: the promotion reload thread (Issue 1) was NOT addressed on the prior head. Serve reload read the replay store while promotions write the operator ledger. See the fix claims below.
Before the fix, the regression test fails: after a promotion is recorded in the operator ledger, reload leaves loaded at None. This is the defect Greptile flagged as Issue 1.

_ServeRules.reload reads the operator ledger at PAPER_LEDGER_PATH, the ledger apply_candidate records to and operator_active_set reads at startup. A promotion recorded there is applied at the next tick boundary. reload creates no ledger when none exists. The unused replay-store field is removed.
The changed files pass ruff check, ruff format --check and mypy --strict.
Replay output is unchanged after the fix: smoke-10m events hash b69c2959...b32d, and the paper smoke cycle completes.
Live stays refused after the fix: run --mode live exits 3 with the unmet preconditions listed and no transaction attempted.

Restart re-attempt: a BUY rejected before the restart writes OrderRejected, which has no side or mint field, so it cannot be matched to its candidate. On resume it becomes eligible again. It relies on the risk engine re-vetoing it deterministically from the replayed state. That is not proven.
The resume match assumes the OrderPlaced ts_utc equals the candidate stamp, because the adapter clock reads the tick at batch write. That is not verified against the latency and mark-refresh path.
